subject: pathology
title: Hashimoto Thyroiditis, Hurthle Cells, de Quervain and Riedel Thyroiditis, and Graves Disease

steps.tx: Hashimoto thyroiditis autoimmune destroys thyroid follicles through lymphocytic infiltration, germinal centres, and Hurthle metaplasia toward hypothyroidism in middle aged women with anti-TPO antibodies. That lymphocytic destruction is **Hashimoto (chronic lymphocytic) thyroiditis**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Lymphocytes, germinal centres, Hurthle cells, rising TSH: Hashimoto thyroiditis under the microscope.

steps.tx: Hurthle cells, oncocytic follicular cells stuffed with mitochondria turning abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, mark Hashimoto metaplasia yet also build Hurthle cell neoplasms requiring capsular invasion judgement. Those pink cells are **Hurthle (oncocytic) cells**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Hurthle cells are mitochondria rich pink follicular cells; in Hashimoto they reassure, in nodules they interrogate.

steps.tx: Subacute de Quervain thyroiditis tenderly inflames thyroid after viral illness with granulomas engulfing colloid, thyrotoxic leakage then hypothyroid recovery phases, low uptake separating leakage from Graves synthesis. That painful gland is **subacute (de Quervain) thyroiditis**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Painful tender thyroid with high hormones but low uptake is leakage, de Quervain thyroiditis, not Graves disease.

vis.caption: Hypothyroidism consequences when thyroid hormone fails early or late.

steps.tx: Riedel thyroiditis fibroses thyroid into woody hardness invading strap muscles and parathyroids, IgG4 related sometimes, mimicking anaplastic cancer while strangling airways slowly. That woody fibrosis is **Riedel (invasive fibrous) thyroiditis**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: A woody rock hard thyroid fixing to neighbours thinks Riedel fibrosis against anaplastic cancer.

steps.tx: Graves disease stimulates TSH receptors with antibodies causing diffuse hyperthyroidism, pretibial myxoedema, and orbitopathy from orbital fibroblast activation independent of hormone levels. That autoimmune stimulation is **Graves disease with thyroid eye disease**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Graves eyes obey antibodies, not hormone levels; eye disease may worsen while thyroid normalises.

steps.tx: Hashimoto and Graves may coexist or succeed each other in autoimmune thyroid spectrum, antibody panels and uptake scans separating hyperfunction causes when treatment diverges. That spectrum thinking is **autoimmune thyroid disease spectrum**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: One autoimmune gland can swing between Graves fire and Hashimoto ash across a lifetime.

steps.tx: Levothyroxine replaces Hashimoto hypothyroidism titrated by TSH, pregnancy raising requirements and newborn screening preventing congenital hypothyroidism cretinism catastrophes. That replacement duty is **levothyroxine in Hashimoto hypothyroidism**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Titrate levothyroxine by TSH, raise it early in pregnancy, and never miss newborn screening.

vis.caption: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma, the invasive mimic Riedel thyroiditis must be separated from.

steps.tx: Lymphoma risk rises slightly in longstanding Hashimoto glands, rapidly enlarging thyroid in Hashimoto patients earning biopsy against MALT lymphoma transformation. That vigilance is **thyroid lymphoma arising in Hashimoto disease**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: A Hashimoto gland suddenly enlarging earns biopsy; primary thyroid lymphoma grows in that soil.
